body.x: TAIPEI, Taiwan (AVING Special Report on 'World Class Brand in Taiwan') -- <Visual News>
BenQ, the Company Responsible for the World-best Monitor Technology

BenQ, one of the representative companies of Taiwan, is being transformed as a global CE and IT company. It started as a typical OEM, ODM suppliers like the conventional Taiwanese manufacturing companies in the past. Recently, however, it has been pushing itself to take another step forward in terms of product branding and business expansion. Particularly, BenQ retains the world-best display technology and it is in fact a parent company of AUO, one of the top-three LCD panel manufacturers in the world. Moreover, in 2005, it had received the spotlight of the world by taking over Siemens, renowned German mobile phone company and later it even became a big sponsor of famous Spanish professional soccer team ‘real madrid’ under the new name of ‘BenQ-Siemens’.

The biggest strength of BenQ Technology is based on its monitor business. In 2005, BenQ successfully launched 2mn response time monitor so far, and last January at CES 2006, it proudly displayed its prototype of 1ms response time monitor, which drew great amount of attention of the visitors. As the internet game is getting more popular as well as other various entertainment contents in the form of video clips, quicker response time of a monitor arises as a key determining factor in purchasing an item among users in the market, particularly gamers.
It would be intriguing to follow the future steps of BenQ which has already dominated the market in terms of market share and advanced technology.
